## 目标
生成一张「FridayOS 智脑」竖版封面海报,深色科技风,作为闭环验证的首个产物。

## 规格
- 尺寸:1200 x 1600 px,RGB
- 背景:深色径向渐变,从中心 #1B2A4A 到边缘 #0A1120
- 主标题:「FridayOS 智脑」字号约 110,居中,白色 #F5F7FA
- 副标题:「AI Agent 的第二大脑」字号约 46,主标题下方,#7FB2FF
- 顶部品牌字:「宣灏科技」字号约 36,#9AA7BD,距顶 120px 居中

```python
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H = 1200, 1600
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H))
px = img.load()
cx, cy = W/2, H/2
maxd = math.hypot(cx, cy)
c0 = (0x1B, 0x2A, 0x4A); c1 = (0x0A, 0x11, 0x20)
for y in range(H):
    for x in range(W):
        t = math.hypot(x-cx, y-cy)/maxd
        px[x, y] = tuple(int(c0[i]+(c1[i]-c0[i])*t) for i in range(3))
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def font(sz):
    for p in [r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyh.ttc", r"C:\Windows\Fonts\msyhbd.ttc"]:
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, sz)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

def center(text, y, fnt, fill):
    b = d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=fnt)
    d.text(((W-(b[2]-b[0]))/2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)

center("宣灏科技", 120, font(36), (0x9A,0xA7,0xBD))
center("FridayOS 智脑", 620, font(110), (0xF5,0xF7,0xFA))
center("AI Agent 的第二大脑", 770, font(46), (0x7F,0xB2,0xFF))
ly = 1080
d.line([(220, ly), (W-220, ly)], fill=(0x2E,0x4A,0x7A), width=3)
for i, dx in enumerate([-60, 0, 60]):
    d.ellipse([cx+dx-8, ly+40-8, cx+dx+8, ly+40+8], fill=(0x7F,0xB2,0xFF))

out = r"D:\Friday\codex_bridge\outbox\fridayos_cover_v1.png"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
img.save(out)
print("SAVED", out)
```

import os
W,H=1200,1600

top=(0x1E,0x1B,0x4B); bot=(0x0F,0x17,0x2A)

    return ImageFont.load_default()

    b=d.textbbox((0,0),text,font=fnt); d.text(((W-(b[2]-b[0]))/2,y),text,font=fnt,fill=fill)

center("FridayOS-Lite",560,font(120,True),(0xF8,0xFA,0xFC))

out=r"D:\Friday\codex_bridge\outbox\lite_hero_poster.png"
